authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government / Office for National Statistics
note: Previously unused official public no-login real-data source window. The Planning Data Local Planning Authority dataset contains administrative boundaries for LPAs in England and currently reports 337 Local Planning Authorities. A bounded window of at most 50 candidates was considered for the unresolved criterion. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative LPA reference/name, local-authority code, local-plan-boundary reference, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector binding any candidate LPA polygon to this slot. Selecting one would invent partition ownership. No coverage_area_id is selected, no coverage Polygon/MultiPolygon is emitted, no source-area record is accepted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
